_about: Everything the coach says about motivation, by event type (see rehab/events.py). Several variants per category; the last 3 used are skipped. Keep phrases short (about 8 words), simple, and only use one when its event was really detected. Opening, check-in and closing lines have one variant on purpose: they are the same every session. Placeholders: {name} {coach} {finger} {what} {part} {activity} {activities} {count} {count_word} {set_word} {sets_word} {plant} {option} {first} {second} {fact} {intro} {goal} {deg}. Goal.<task> words a daily task from benchmarks/benchmarks.json (Gates 2016) as her goal.
